plugins.name: context-window-manager
plugins.description: Session context-window handoff and resume: save session state to a home-scoped, per-repo CONTEXT-*.md file and resume from it with git-drift and stale-reference checks.

plugins.name: ccu
plugins.description: Forecast weekly Claude Code quota usage: project a finish percentage, per-active-day burn-down rate, and exhaustion date from current usage and the next reset, weighting elapsed time by configured active hours and blackout days.

plugins.name: test-pruner
plugins.description: Map test layers, find redundant tests, and plan safe pruning.
